changes.historical_text: Destroy 1 face-down monster and remove it from play. If the monster is a Flip Effect Monster, both players check their respective Decks and remove all monsters of the same name from play. Then shuffle the Decks.
changes.modern_text: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Flip monster, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name.
changes.summary: Wording modernisation only: the goat variant's Lua script is byte-identical to the modern script (comment-only diff), and every English text revision (v3 through v10) preserves the same resolution, including the mandatory both-players deck check on a Flip monster hit.

review.notes: Upstream ships the variant for period display text; behaviour is identical. GOAT keeps the code for entry-for-entry parity with the reference list via an explicit include. Packet confirms the basis: script_diff is empty, and the modern text still spells the era procedure out ('each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name'), so the mutual mandatory Deck reveal that EdisonFormat.com documents for this card is already what the modern script does - the period ruling is real but produces no divergence to implement.
